ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there are two vertical parallel lines, intersected by a lower oblique line. At the intersection of the lower oblique line and the left vertical line, ∠1 is located at the lower left; at the intersection of the lower oblique line and the right vertical line, ∠4 is located at the lower right. Reasoning: Regard the lower oblique line as a transversal; it intersects the two parallel vertical lines. ∠1 and ∠4 are exterior angles on the same side, therefore they are supplementary, and their sum is 180°. Given m∠1 = 123°, so m∠4 = 180° - 123° = 57°.
